title: Buy vs build decision
goal: Show an engineering decision tree that balances capability, security, cost, and delivery time.

rubric.must: The root visibly asks whether a product meets critical requirements and separates buy-oriented from build-oriented paths.
The buy path visibly checks both vendor security/compliance and approved-budget cost before Buy and integrate.
The no-product path visibly checks MVP delivery deadline and long-term ownership capacity before Build in-house.
The visible leaves include negotiation, compliant-platform, reduced-scope, and deferred-custom-feature outcomes.
The tree shows readable Yes and No branches at each decision.

ideal.notes: Redrawn from the source with the independent taxonomy exemplar drawing script; no engine geometry or screenshot used to build the target.

review.evidence: Visually reviewed against the taxonomy exemplar and source: complete questions and outcomes, numbered hexagons, unambiguous Yes/No drops, and a shared outcome row. No clipped labels or material collisions. Unclassified outcomes remain neutral.
